# [18.3.0](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/compare/v18.2.1...v18.3.0) (2026-11-24)


### Bug Fixes

* allow trailing tabs after closing code fences ([#4241](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4241)) ([1e11902](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/1e1190241b4a8f16d6bfa232e183f581eb617964))
* avoid quadratic scan on adjacent inline links ([#4274](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4274)) ([f5ffd22](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/f5ffd221ba5fc7f077d867ac2fc3f7a06855da94))
* avoid quadratic time on long local part before @ in GFM text ([#4225](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4225)) ([c6b22e8](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/c6b22e89baca9dfa4ed074380a511781e1c35e4a))
* check own properties on extensions.renderers in Parser ([#4271](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4271)) ([c572307](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/c57230757e32a2b27c4bc75b1274b25e379fd465))
* honor the CLI end-of-options marker ([#4230](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4230)) ([a1ddc72](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/a1ddc722e797b8315a56ea2ab66043da294364af))
* keep an indented code block after a list item paragraph ([#4198](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4198)) ([b9e3824](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/b9e3824233a381aa476ae9a9d9c4827fb25c601c))
* preserve literal entities in image alt text ([#4232](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4232)) ([04f1c6e](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/04f1c6e5189076d38b00d41acf9bff235532123a))
* reject CLI options missing their values ([#4261](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4261)) ([502e658](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/502e658115a8db1aec6157c2560cde913b78c4f6))
* skip missing optional childTokens properties in walkTokens ([#4262](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4262)) ([283f74f](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/283f74f24bc6df1c39c4b2a74ef923a68752e6e5))
* wait for CLI error output before exiting ([#4263](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4263)) ([6c2a5ab](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/6c2a5ab48d475d66adb19d2909929a6447130c52))


### Features

* add inBlockquote to lexer state ([#4222](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4222)) ([201bfce](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/201bfce495e6e57be6f2c91e822e65f33a546040)), closes [#4184](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4184) [#4221](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4221)


### Performance Improvements

* avoid scanning table bodies for header-only decisions ([#4213](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4213)) ([a0925cc](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/a0925cca0227082e83feb2461115fbef1a30ecca))
* skip paragraph lookahead for initial quoted code ([#4233](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4233)) ([171f177](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/171f177a42f09d4812c68b045c3bb50122f6b2aa))
